title.en: Planned and Under-Construction Project Realization Assumptions and U.S. Data Center Capacity Outcomes (Table 4)
title.zh: 规划与在建项目的实现率假设及美国数据中心容量结果（表4）

description.en: Realization-rate assumptions (shares completed by 2032 / after 2032, separately for observed and imputed capacity) and resulting capacity outcomes in GW (By 2032 / After 2032 / Never) for each completion-year category of planned and under-construction U.S. data center projects. Operational capacity and all 2025 capacity are included in full.
description.zh: 对美国规划与在建数据中心项目按完工年份档给出的实现率假设（观测容量与插值容量分别设定 2032 年前/后完工比例），以及由此得到的容量结果（GW，分 2032 年前完工/2032 年后完工/永不完工三列）。在运容量与全部 2025 年容量按全额计入。

notes: No-date planned projects (required, PDF p.25): for reported (observed) capacity, 20 percent is completed by 2032, 30 percent after 2032, and 50 percent is never realized; for imputed capacity, the corresponding shares are 10 percent, 25 percent, and 65 percent.

Table 4 notes (PDF p.24): rates apply only to planned and under-construction projects; operational capacity and all 2025 capacity are included in full; “Never” is the residual capacity not completed; columns may not sum exactly because of rounding.

The 2025 row's four rate cells show “–” in the paper (no rates apply; 2025 capacity is included in full) and are stored as null in data/raw/capacity.json; this view's rows carry only the GW outcome columns, with the rate assumptions reproduced verbatim in the notes below.

Interpretation (PDF p.24): the residual “Never” category captures cancellation and downsizing; the realization shares should be interpreted as capacity-weighted outcomes rather than project-level cancellation probabilities. For dated projects through 2032, the share completed by 2032 declines with the reported completion horizon and is lower when capacity must be imputed.

Scenario scope (PDF pp.24–25): Table 4 divides the 516.7 GW gross post-2024 pipeline into three outcomes — 188.3 GW operational by end-2032, 114.9 GW completed after 2032, 213.5 GW never completed. The calculation is “a scenario for realized capacity, not as a forecast that every project is built on its reported schedule.”

Composition of the 188.3 GW buildout (PDF p.25): 22.5 GW associated with projects operational in 2025 or 2026, 147.2 GW of planned or under-construction capacity with observed MW, and 18.6 GW with imputed MW.

No-date category (PDF p.25): of the 313.9 GW associated with 717 planned or under-construction projects without a completion date (capacity imputed for 234 of them), 54.0 GW is completed by 2032, 89.8 GW after 2032, and 170.2 GW never; “because this category accounts for most of the gross pipeline, its ultimate realization remains the largest source of uncertainty in the central scenario.”

Exclusions (PDF p.25): projects completed by the end of 2024, together with operational projects without a reported completion year, are part of the pre-2025 installed base and excluded from the buildout calculations.

Realization-rate assumptions of Table 4 (percent of capacity; observed by-2032/after-2032, imputed by-2032/after-2032; kept out of the fixed row schema, values verbatim — the 2025 row prints '–' in the paper and is null in raw): 2025: –/–, –/–; 2026: 90/0, 80/0; 2027: 80/5, 65/10; 2028: 70/10, 55/15; 2029: 60/15, 45/20; 2030: 50/20, 35/25; 2031: 40/25, 25/30; 2032: 30/30, 20/30; After 2032: 0/50, 0/50; Planned, no date: 20/30, 10/25.
Column mapping from raw: by_2032_gw→gw_by_2032, after_2032_gw→gw_after_2032, never_gw→gw_never; values verbatim.

provenance.quote_en: Table 4. Planned and Under-Construction Project Realization Assumptions and U.S. Data Center Capacity Outcomes
Rates apply only to planned and under-construction projects; operational capacity and all 2025 capacity are included in full.

The residual “Never” category captures cancellation and downsizing; the realization shares should therefore be interpreted as capacity-weighted outcomes rather than project-level cancellation probabilities.
Table 4 divides the 516.7 GW gross post-2024 pipeline into three outcomes.
For reported capacity, we assume that 20 percent is completed by 2032, 30 percent is completed after 2032, and 50 percent is never realized.
For imputed capacity, the corresponding shares are 10 percent, 25 percent, and 65 percent.

The 188.3 GW buildout consists of 22.5 GW associated with projects that are operational in 2025 or 2026, 147.2 GW of planned or under-construction capacity for which MW are observed, and 18.6 GW for which MW are imputed.

Consequently, of the 313.9 GW associated with 717 planned or under-construction projects without a completion date, 54.0 GW is completed by 2032, 89.8 GW is completed after 2032, and 170.2 GW is never completed.
